dedupe_keys.name: borehole database of the mississippi river valley alluvial aquifer mrva

description: Frank Tsai and Yuqi Song at Louisiana State University publish borehole lithology for the Mississippi River Valley Alluvial Aquifer in the United States. The June 2025 release is freely downloadable under CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial reuse requires separate permission. Its README describes a sand versus fine-grained collection with 75,277 logs and a gravel classification collection using 35,560 driller logs plus 162 borings. Coordinates use USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic in metres, and layer-top and bottom elevations reference NAVD88. These tables can constrain aquifer architecture and groundwater-flow simulations for drinking-water and irrigation planning. The two well-identifier fields refer to different collections and must not be joined as if they were interchangeable. Historical drilling dates and classification uncertainty remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these tables. Lithological recoding and subsurface continuity were not independently checked, and no borehole data were downloaded.
